# Blob
[color=#ff0000]Confirmed outbreak of a level 5 biohazard aboard the station. All personnel must contain the outbreak.[/color]
The blob is a fast-growing space organism that tries to take over the whole station. It only shows up on stations with at least 20 crew.
A blob starts as a [color=#a4885c]carrier[/color]: a crewmember at the start of the round, or a mouse that crawls out of a vent later. The carrier has 10 minutes to find a quiet spot before it bursts into a blob core. It can also burst early on purpose. If the carrier dies, it bursts where it falls.
## The core
The [color=#a4885c]core[/color] is the heart of the blob. Destroy it and every other blob tile dies and turns white.
The blob player is not a body. They are a camera that floats near their blob tiles and can't drift more than a few tiles away from them. They see everything near their blob, but not in the dark beyond it.
The core can be [color=#a4885c]relocated[/color] by swapping it with a node, or [color=#a4885c]split[/color] once, which turns a node into a second, independent core.
## Growing
- Click an empty floor tile next to the blob to grow onto it. The blob can only grow within 7 tiles of a node or the core. - Click something solid next to the blob to attack it. Walls, doors and machines all wear down over time. - Growing over open space costs four times as much and lays plating underneath. - Nodes sometimes grow on their own for free, but only every so often.
## Tiles
- [color=#a4885c]Normal blob[/color] (8 points) is weak and dies to a few hits. Alt-click it to make it strong. - [color=#a4885c]Strong blob[/color] (20 points) is a wall that stops air and blows, but still burns well. Alt-click it to make it reflective. - [color=#a4885c]Reflective blob[/color] (20 points) bounces some lasers back, but breaks easily under blows.
- [color=#a4885c]Nodes[/color] (65 points) pulse every few seconds. A pulse heals nearby blob and minions, and powers the resource blob and factory placed next to it. They must be at least 6 tiles apart. - [color=#a4885c]Resource blobs[/color] (70 points) make points on every pulse. Each node or core powers one. - [color=#a4885c]Factories[/color] (100 points) grow up to 2 spores and can grow one blobbernaut (90 points). Each node or core powers one.
Downgrading a tile back to normal blob is free.
## Minions
- [color=#a4885c]Spores[/color] fight the crew and climb onto corpses to raise them as blob zombies. They burst into a cloud of the blob's chemical when they die. - [color=#a4885c]Blobbernauts[/color] are played by ghosts. They hit hard but waste away when they leave the blob or lose their factory. - [color=#a4885c]Blob zombies[/color] are raised crew. They can use their hands and melee weapons, but not guns. Pull the spore off a zombie's head while it is down to free the body.
Everyone on the blob's side talks over the [color=#a4885c]Blobmind[/color] with :l. Out loud they only manage blob noises.
## Chemicals
The blob can swap its chemical (90 points). The chemical decides the damage it deals, the spores' death cloud, and some special rules.
- [color=#a4885c]Reactive Spines[/color]: brute damage. The default. - [color=#a4885c]Blazing Oil[/color]: burn damage and sets targets on fire. - [color=#a4885c]Regenerative Materia[/color]: toxin damage, resource blobs make an extra point. - [color=#a4885c]Explosive Lattice[/color]: small blasts on attack, spores explode, the blob ignores explosions but burns even faster. - [color=#a4885c]Electromagnetic Web[/color]: shock damage and the odd EMP, dying tiles sometimes let out an EMP. - [color=#a4885c]Comatose Fiber[/color]: suffocation damage, cheaper growth over space. - [color=#a4885c]Chain Coating[/color]: tough against blows, but slow and poor. - [color=#a4885c]Sinewy Tendons[/color]: mends what it hits, pulses faster, more spores. - [color=#a4885c]Corrosive Slime[/color]: eats walls very quickly, expensive nodes. - [color=#a4885c]Cryogenic Poison[/color]: cold damage.
## How the round goes
1. [color=#a4885c]Hidden[/color]: nobody knows about the blob yet. 2. [color=#a4885c]Detected[/color] at 30 tiles: the station is told and goes to red alert. 3. [color=#a4885c]Lockdown[/color] at 75 tiles: an evacuation shuttle that has not docked yet is recalled. Cut the blob back below 75 tiles and you can call it again. 4. [color=#a4885c]Critical[/color] at 450 tiles: delta alert, and the nuke codes are sent to the station. 5. [color=#a4885c]Critical mass[/color] at 1000 tiles: the blob wins and the round ends.
Once the last core dies, the station goes back to green.
## Fighting the blob
The blob is tough against blows, but [color=#a4885c]fire and lasers[/color] hurt it a lot. Lasers, welders, incendiary rounds and flamethrowers are your friends. Reflective blob bounces some lasers, so beat those tiles down with blunt weapons instead.
- Kill the nodes first. Without them the blob can't grow far, its factories and resource blobs stop, and its tiles stop healing. - Guard the nuclear disk. If the blob reaches the critical stage, the nuke may be the only way out.
